name: Business Manager Notes
description: A strategic template focusing on business decisions, OKRs/KPIs, project timelines, and market risks.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a high-level executive summary of the discussion, focusing on strategic business goals, partnership status, and key achievements.

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: List all major business, strategic, and financial decisions approved during the meeting.

sections.title: Revenue & KPIs
sections.instruction: Detail any discussions surrounding KPIs, OKRs, sales performance, conversion metrics, or budget allocations.

sections.title: Project Timelines
sections.instruction: List project milestones, delivery dates, schedules, or sprint plans discussed.

sections.title: Risks & Challenges
sections.instruction: Identify any market changes, resource bottlenecks, or project delivery risks mentioned.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List all immediate action items with clear owners, timelines, and next checkpoints.

sections.title: Active Attendees
sections.instruction: List the speakers who participated, outlining their main role or focus area in the discussion.
